0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The overwrought dragon can no longer find it in himself to relax.

24.original: Scout the area around Reah Tahra.

48.original: Hark! The grinding and shuddering of steel bodies... The metal, it cometh!

49.original: ...Thou hearest naught? Mayhaps thy species hath not the sensitivity... Yet the machines come nevertheless.

50.original: Seek a vantage from which even thou mayest witness their dread approach...then hearken unto my words, and flee.

51.original: Flee, stranger, shouldst thou value thy life.

52.original: No one but dragons here. Forsooth!

53.original: Thou art returned... What didst thou ken?

55.original: ...Perhaps thou speakest in sooth. That mechanical cacophony plagueth me without cease... Though I swear 'tis clearer now than it hath ever been.

56.original: Should this be naught but mine own fears, returned fiercer with each coming... I know not how to quit myself of them.

58.original: Find strength in your comrades, and together overcome your fears.

59.original: You must embrace your fear to truly understand it.

60.original: You should fear nothing, as I do.

61.original: Thou art strong. Had my kin sought what thou hast found, perhaps our star would have met a different fate...

62.original: Thou art strong. Would that my kin had sought what thou hast found...

63.original: ...Though there may yet be time. Naught can alter history's course, but the future awaiteth still. I thank thee for thine insight, courageous one.
